name: Logs
description: What you did, one file per entry: workouts, sleep, meals, study sessions. Areas are set in its settings.
forAgents: What the user did (a workout, a meal, sleep, study) is a log: `log.create`.

week-goals.description: this week against each area's weekly goal

areas.description: the areas to show (slugs); every area with a goal when left out

area.description: an area's weeks and latest sessions

meta.description: a field, or a list of them, shown on each session

total.description: a number field summed over this week

empty.description: the text when there's nothing logged yet
